meta_data.base_class: Analyze data from <social media platforms> to extract clues about missing persons - refers to various social media platforms that can be used for data analysis.

tool_template.name: SocialMediaInvestigator_analyze_<class>_data
tool_template.description: Analyzes data from <class> to extract clues about activities related to missing persons.

socialMediaAccounts.description: List of <class> account identifiers to be analyzed.

locationAnalysis.description: Specifies whether to perform location tracking from <class> posts.

sentimentAnalysis.description: Specifies whether to analyze the sentiment of the <class> posts.

languagePreferences.description: Preferred languages for the <class> posts to be analyzed.

dataPrivacyLevel.description: The level of data privacy compliance to adhere to while analyzing <class> data, such as 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

dataFormat.description: The preferred data format for exporting <class> analysis results, e.g., 'JSON', 'CSV'.

keywordFilters.description: A list of keywords to filter the <class> posts for specific content relevance.

timeZone.description: The time zone context for interpreting the timestamps of <class> data, e.g., 'UTC', 'PST'.

contentType.description: Type of content to focus on during analysis on <class>, such as 'text', 'image', or 'video'.
